title: Have any of you seen the red rabbit???
content: A few months ago I had a new dream and I saw something that I don’t think I’ve ever seen before in my dream world, I can’t stop thinking about it and I guess I’m just curious if any of you have experienced anything similar or if I should chalk this one up to just a random weird dream… …also, I tried to make an image but the AI kept getting it wrong so I’m going to try to explain it and I’ll also try to keep it as short as I can without removing too many details… Here goes; the world is different, it’s post apocalyptic and somehow I know some kind of disaster or something has happened, I’m not sure what but whatever it was I just know that it was bad…I’m walking in the bleak gray world, there are a few other people walking as well and they all look ragged and tattered and sad, they stare at the ground without looking up. I am leaving what I call “the gas station” (a familiar/regular place I visit in my dream world) and I’m walking along beside a tall chain link fence with curled barbed wire around the top that circles a tall multi-level cold gray concrete building on the inside, some chunks of concrete have broken off and lay fallen on the ground below in chunks, it is rundown and damaged in some places. I stop and turn to look at the building and notice a white sign hanging on the chain link with wire, I can’t remember exactly what it said but it read something like “WARNING” or “DANGER” in big red letters, below that was a silhouette/filled in outline of the side profile of a rabbit also in red with a couple more sentences that I can’t remember below it, I think it was some kind of disease or sickness maybe and maybe the people inside the building were infected but I just can’t seem to remember no matter how hard I try to. Like I said, maybe there’s nothing to this one and maybe it was just random but I figured it didn’t hurt to share because I’m learning that there’s almost always the possibility someone else has had a similar experience, I’ve been calling this dream “the red rabbit dream”, feel free to weigh in anytime… 🐇💤
